_meta.title: Kingshot Hero Database
_meta.description: Every Kingshot hero with generation, rarity, troop type, rally/garrison/bear/joiner tiers (plus a gathering tier for the four Generation 0 heroes) and F2P notes.

provenance.method: Community tier-list consensus cross-referenced across the sources above (April 2026). Hero names and generation assignments are cross-verified: 27 heroes against four sites, and the four Generation 0 gathering heroes (Edwin, Forrest, Olive, Seth) against two, kingshotdata.com and kingshotguide.org (2026-04-14). Tier rankings reflect community consensus, not a single authority.
provenance.editorialNote: Hero names, rarities, troop types and generations are verified facts (95). The tier rankings (rally/garrison/bear/joiner) are our team and community judgement — opinion, not a measured game value.

heroes.name: Amadeus
heroes.desc: One of the strongest offensive heroes in the game. His first skill provides dependable rally value. Remains S-tier for rallies across all generations. Amadeus is a VIP hero — access is gated behind VIP progression, which in practice requires spending to reach quickly.

heroes.name: Jabel
heroes.desc: The foundational garrison tank. Extremely robust and available early. Core of any defensive lineup from day one through late game.

heroes.name: Helga
heroes.desc: A decent early offensive hero who serves as an Amadeus alternative. Falls off in later generations as stronger rally leads become available.

heroes.name: Saul
heroes.desc: An S-tier joiner for garrison defense via stacking. Also invaluable for F2P players due to construction speed boosts. Dual-purpose hero: city management and garrison.

heroes.name: Zoe
heroes.desc: The F2P garrison MVP. Remains viable well into Gen 5-6 with proper support. Her defensive capabilities, damage reduction, and crowd control are unmatched for free players.

heroes.name: Hilde
heroes.desc: A dedicated healer who can also disable enemies briefly. One of the best healers in the game. S-tier joiner for garrison stacking.

heroes.name: Marlin
heroes.desc: Excellent ranged damage dealer. A long-term F2P investment — aim for 465 shards to reach 4-stars quickly when available. Excels in both PvE and PvP, powerful in arena and expedition.

heroes.name: Petra
heroes.desc: The premier cavalry rally lead. Often featured in Hero Roulette events, making her accessible to F2P players. Flexible hero that excels on offense.

heroes.name: Eric
heroes.desc: A solid garrison infantry defender who joins the defensive rotation. Reliable but not as impactful as Zoe for F2P players.

heroes.name: Jaeger
heroes.desc: Garrison-oriented archer who strengthens defensive lineups. Lower priority for F2P players compared to Marlin.

heroes.name: Rosa
heroes.desc: Strong offensive archer and arena specialist. Accessible through specific events. Only invest if you see a clear path to consistent shard collection.

heroes.name: Alcar
heroes.desc: Premium garrison infantry defender. Strong in garrison and bear hunt but typically requires significant investment.

heroes.name: Margot
heroes.desc: Excels in garrison defense and bear hunt. A strong joiner who adds depth to both defensive and PvE lineups.

heroes.name: Vivian
heroes.desc: One of the most impactful heroes in the game. Provides army-wide damage buffs that elevate entire rally lineups. S+ tier for rallies.

heroes.name: Thrud
heroes.desc: A powerful cavalry multiplier who amplifies cavalry-heavy rally compositions. Strong on offense with some garrison flexibility.

heroes.name: Long Fei
heroes.desc: Late-game garrison infantry specialist. Strong across garrison and bear hunt. A premium investment for defensive players.

heroes.name: Yang
heroes.desc: The F2P late-game MVP. Provides significant rally impact and is accessible through challenging events, alliance activities, and daily play. Prioritize saving shards for Yang from Gen 5 onward.

heroes.name: Sophia
heroes.desc: A cavalry debuffer who disrupts enemy formations with confusion effects. Strong rally presence with some garrison capability.

heroes.name: Triton
heroes.desc: The strongest frontline unit in Gen 6. Dominates garrison defense and is a solid bear hunt contributor.

heroes.name: Chenko
heroes.desc: His first skill provides dependable rally value — considered the best rally joiner skill for F2P players. Essential for bear hunt participation.

heroes.name: Amane
heroes.desc: An excellent offensive stacking joiner for bear hunt and rallies. Pairs well with archer-heavy compositions.

heroes.name: Yeonwoo
heroes.desc: A reliable joiner whose offensive contribution does not rely on chance mechanics. Consistent value in rally and bear hunt.

heroes.name: Gordon
heroes.desc: A reliable early-game hero who provides decent value until stronger options become available.

heroes.name: Howard
heroes.desc: Limited utility — garrison only. Quickly outclassed by Gen 2+ heroes. Low priority for investment.

heroes.name: Quinn
heroes.desc: Low boost value with limited combat utility. Not recommended for significant investment.

heroes.name: Diana
heroes.desc: No battle skills — she is a gathering hero only. Useful for resource farming with farm accounts but has zero combat value.

heroes.name: Fahd
heroes.desc: Very low priority. Only use if you have absolutely no other joiner options. Quickly outclassed.

heroes.name: Edwin
heroes.desc: Edwin is a Rare (R-grade) cavalry gathering hero in Kingshot — used on farm accounts for stone production. His Expedition skills directly boost Town Quarry Output (+25%) and Wilderness Stone Gathering Speed (+25%), making him essential for players who maintain gathering marches.

heroes.name: Forrest
heroes.desc: Forrest is a Rare infantry gathering hero — the wood-focused counterpart to Edwin (stone) and Seth (iron). His Expedition boosts Town Sawmill Output and Wood Gathering Speed by up to +25% each.

heroes.name: Olive
heroes.desc: Olive is a Rare archer gathering hero — the bread-focused specialist. Her Expedition boosts Town Mill Output and Wilderness Bread Gathering Speed by up to +25% each.

heroes.name: Seth
heroes.desc: Seth is a Rare infantry gathering hero — the iron-focused specialist completing the R-grade gathering quartet (Edwin/stone, Forrest/wood, Olive/bread, Seth/iron). His Expedition boosts Town Iron Output and Wilderness Iron Gathering Speed by up to +25%.
